import types
from scrapy.extensions.throttle import AutoThrottle
def trace(settings, steps):
    c = make_crawler(dict({'AUTOTHROTTLE_ENABLED': True}, **settings))
    slot = types.SimpleNamespace(delay=0.0, transferring=set())
    c.engine = types.SimpleNamespace(downloader=types.SimpleNamespace(_delay=None, slots={'k': slot}))
    at = AutoThrottle.from_crawler(c)
    at._spider_opened(c.spider)
    slot.delay = c.engine.downloader._delay
    out = [c.engine.downloader._delay]
    for latency, status in steps:
        req = Request('http://example.test/', meta={'download_slot': 'k', 'download_latency': latency})
        at._response_downloaded(Response('http://example.test/', status=status), req, c.spider)
        out.append(round(slot.delay, 6))
    return out
result = [trace({'AUTOTHROTTLE_START_DELAY': 4.0}, [(2.0, 200), (1.0, 200), (10.0, 200)]),
          trace({'AUTOTHROTTLE_START_DELAY': 1.0, 'DOWNLOAD_DELAY': 2.0, 'AUTOTHROTTLE_MAX_DELAY': 5.0}, [(0.1, 200), (30.0, 200)]),

import os
from scrapy.extensions.httpcache import FilesystemCacheStorage
from scrapy.utils.request import fingerprint
out = {}
for gz in (False, True):
    d = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), 'fs%d' % gz)
    c = make_crawler({'HTTPCACHE_DIR': d, 'HTTPCACHE_GZIP': gz})
    st = FilesystemCacheStorage(c.settings)
    st.open_spider(c.spider)
    r = Request('http://example.test/a')
    st.store_response(c.spider, r, Response('http://example.test/a', body=b'B', request=r))
    fp = fingerprint(r).hex()
    path = os.path.join(d, c.spider.name, fp[:2], fp)
    got = st.retrieve_response(c.spider, Request('http://example.test/a'))
    out[str(gz)] = [sorted(os.listdir(path)), got.body, open(os.path.join(path, 'response_body'), 'rb').read() == b'B']
    st.close_spider(c.spider)
result = out

import os
from scrapy.downloadermiddlewares.httpcache import HttpCacheMiddleware
settings = {'HTTPCACHE_ENABLED': True, 'HTTPCACHE_DIR': os.path.join(os.getcwd(), 'cache'),
            'HTTPCACHE_POLICY': 'scrapy.extensions.httpcache.RFC2616Policy'}

import gzip, zlib, brotli
from scrapy.downloadermiddlewares.httpcompression import HttpCompressionMiddleware
mw, c = component(HttpCompressionMiddleware)
r = Request('http://example.test/')
mw.process_request(r)
out = [sorted(x.strip() for x in r.headers.get('Accept-Encoding').decode().split(','))]
body = b'<html>' + b'x' * 50 + b'</html>'
for enc, data in (('gzip', gzip.compress(body)), ('deflate', zlib.compress(body)), ('br', brotli.compress(body))):
    resp = Response('http://example.test/', body=data, headers={'Content-Encoding': enc, 'Content-Type': 'text/html'}, request=r)
    new = mw.process_response(r, resp)
    out.append([enc, new.body == body, new.headers.get('Content-Encoding'), kind(new)])
result = out
